from datatrove.pipeline.filters.base_filter import BaseFilter

class Batched(BaseFilter):
    name = "batched"
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(batch_size=2)
        self.sizes = []
    def filter(self, doc):
        return "x" not in doc.text
    def filter_batch(self, batch):
        self.sizes.append(len(batch))
        return [self.filter(doc) for doc in batch]

from datatrove.pipeline.base import PipelineStep
class Upper(PipelineStep):
    name = "upper"
    type = "custom"
    def run(self, data, rank=0, world_size=1):
        for doc in data:
            with self.track_time():
                self.stat_update("chars", value=len(doc.text))
                self.stat_update("docs", "seen")
                doc.text = doc.text.upper()
            self.update_doc_stats(doc)
            yield doc
block = Upper()
